verdict.rationale: Lorikeet mentions zero-data-retention agreements with model vendors and no fine-tuning on customer data, plus SOC2-style independently verified reports on a trust center, which touches data retention posture at the vendor-model level. However, there is no evidence of user-facing controls letting an AI-native user configure or request deletion/retention of their own conversation or account data within Lorikeet itself. Missing for 10: explicit customer-data deletion/export controls, retention period configuration, and user-initiated deletion workflows.
